task: T-030 / Web viewer sees the audience of the selected stream
change: A viewer with an active voice lease and confirmed LiveKit subscription can read the audience of the selected screen stream. The authenticated API verifies both current leases in the same open voice channel and the active viewer-to-track subscription. The selected stream's participant strip shows the watcher count and marks its viewers, including the local viewer; the stream owner's audience remains separate.
